label: TP
reason: User-supplied Referer header flows via URL decoding into param, which is passed to doSomething. The conditional (500/42)+num>200 evaluates to true (approx 21+196=217), allowing param to be assigned to bar. Bar is then used as a tainted argument in printf, enabling format string attacks.

evidence.note: Referer header decoded into param, passed to doSomething, condition allows param->bar assignment, bar used in printf sink
